wordProblems.q: A hall has 9 rows of chairs with 8 chairs in each row. The teacher adds 15 more chairs. How many chairs are there in all?
Ella collects 22 shells on Saturday and 36 shells on Sunday. Ella gives 5 shells to a friend. How many shells does Ella have left?
Mason has 18 buttons. Mason buys twice as many buttons as Mason already has, plus 12 more. How many buttons does Mason have now?
Nora, Sophia and Ella each have 9 pencils. Their teacher gives them 10 more pencils to share. How many pencils do they have in all?
Liam has 36 stickers. Liam gives away 27 stickers, then buys 3 packs with the same number of stickers left in each pack. How many stickers does Liam buy?
There are 30 red cars and 24 blue cars in a car park. 25 cars drive away. How many cars are left in the car park?
A ticket costs $5. Sam buys 3 tickets and a snack for $5. How many dollars does Sam spend in all?
Sam buys 5 packs of 8 pens and 3 packs of 4 pencils. How many pens and pencils does Sam buy in all?
73 children go on a school trip. 25 children ride in the first bus. The rest ride in the second bus. How many children ride in the second bus?
A baker makes 5 trays with 11 cookies on each tray. Her family eats 19 cookies. How many cookies are left?
Isabella plants 6 rows of carrots with 9 carrots in each row. Then Isabella plants 13 more carrots. How many carrots did Isabella plant in all?
Isabella saves $4 every week for 3 weeks. Then Isabella spends $6 on a game. How many dollars does Isabella have left?
A library has 5 shelves with 12 books on each shelf. The librarian adds 8 more books. How many books are there in all?
A shop has 3 boxes with 6 apples in each box. The shop sells 9 apples. How many apples are left?
Ava has 35 red beads and 27 blue beads. Ava uses 29 beads to make a necklace. How many beads does Ava have left?
A cook has 4 cartons with 12 eggs in each carton. She uses 20 eggs to bake cakes. How many eggs are left?
Isabella scores 16 points in the first game and 20 points in the second game. Isabella gets 13 bonus points. How many points does Isabella have in all?
A farmer fills 5 baskets with 7 oranges in each basket. He gives 13 oranges to his neighbours. How many oranges are left?
Ella is reading a book with 64 pages. Ella reads 26 pages on Monday and 22 pages on Tuesday. How many pages are left to read?
A class has 5 groups with 7 children in each group. 9 children are away today. How many children are at school?
A school has 6 classes with 7 children in each class. 8 new children join, and 17 children are away today. How many children are at school today?
Nora has 17 ribbons. Her mum gives her twice as many ribbons as she already has, then Nora gives 13 ribbons to a friend. How many ribbons does Nora have now?
A shop has 4 crates with 6 bottles of juice in each crate. The shop sells 15 bottles. How many bottles are left?
Mason scores 29 points on Monday, 11 points on Tuesday and 17 points on Wednesday. How many points does Mason score in all?
Layla plants 9 rows of beans with 4 seeds in each row. 23 seeds grow into plants. How many seeds do not grow?
An adult ticket costs $7 and a child ticket costs $6. James buys 3 adult tickets and 2 child tickets. How many dollars does James spend in all?
Sara is reading a book with 73 pages. Sara reads 22 pages on Friday and 11 pages on Saturday. How many pages are left to read?
A market has 4 baskets with 7 apples in each basket and 2 baskets with 5 pears in each basket. The market sells 9 pieces of fruit. How many pieces of fruit are left?
A cook bakes 4 trays with 6 cupcakes on each tray. The children eat 4 cupcakes. How many cupcakes are left?
Nora has $83. Nora buys a ball for $18 and a hat for $30. How many dollars does Nora have left?
